text:
morgan: FYI, security triage for multiple inference libs. protobuf CVE, vLLM mem leak, Triton/FlashAttention kernel flaw, sentencepiece path issue.
jia: which CVEs specifically? links?
alex: CVE-2026-1033 for protobuf (parsing RCE edge), CVE-2026-1102 vLLM OOM/mem-corruption, Triton kernel CVE-2026-1210 affects certain FlashAttention kernels on driver X, sentencepiece CVE-2026-1099 path traversal.
morgan: ok. Priorities: protobuf RCE highest (prod hostable), Triton kernel high for Dedicated & Private, vLLM mid (patch available but needs perf testing), sentencepiece low for hosted but still patch.
sam: do we have patches? I opened PRs:
- proto bump to 3.20.4 (https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4567)
- vllm 0.9.2 with fix (https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4572)
- triton kernel backport 2.13.1 (internal kernel package) (https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4580)
- sentencepiece 0.1.97 (https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4579)
jia: can we do a staggered rollout? protobuf first on hosted API edge, then Dedicated pools, then Private images.
morgan: agree. Hosted => immediate patch in next patch window (tonight 02:00 UTC). Dedicated => canary on low-traffic pools tomorrow morning. Private => provide release notes & docker tags for customers.
security-oncall: need RBAC + audit logging checks for the protobuf fix? any new privileged operations in updated libs?
alex: no new privileges, but we should add audit events around model load failures and kernel fallsbacks. I'll add an event in runtime: `model.kernel.fallback`.
taylor: KMS consideration: some fixes touch model artifact unpacking. We must ensure no changes to key usage. I'll run integration tests with customer KMS (AWS KMS) keys.
devops-bot: sched-canary: canary deployment for triton-kernel scheduled at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z on pool 'dedicated-low', id: canary-8912 :hammer_and_wrench:
sam: perf risk for vLLM bump — runs a new allocator. Need perf baseline: @alex can you run 5x throughput tests (seq len 512) and post numbers?
alex: on it, will post numbers in this thread.
security-oncall: add immediate mitigations: WAF rules to block suspicious proto payloads, rate-limit large parse requests, and enable verbose audit for next 72h.
morgan: agreed. Also tag customer-impacting models and notify Solutions for Private customers with guidance.
jia: owners: protobuf patch = sam, triton kernel = alex, vLLM perf validation = alex, sentencepiece = taylor, customer comms = jia.
sam: I'll merge proto PR after quick smoke and release notes. ETA 4h.
alex: perf numbers: vLLM 0.9.2 vs 0.9.1 => 2% latency p95 increase, throughput -3% at seq512. Acceptable for hosted canary.
morgan: plan: merge proto PR tonight, enable audit verbose, canary triton tomorrow, vLLM canary after perf ok, ship sentencepiece patch in next minor release.
security-oncall: I'll open a post-incident ticket to track follow-ups: INFSEC-3219.
taylor: I'll validate KMS and confirm no key rotation impact.
devops-bot: deploy-success: protobuf patch deployed to hosted-edge canary group at 2026-03-20T02:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
morgan: thanks team. if anything blocks, @security-oncall escalate to Incident channel.
